Register Now: https://cppcon.org/
12th-18th September 2026 - Aurora, Colorado, USA

Join us for CppCon, the annual week-long face-to-face gathering for the entire C++ community. This conference is organized by the C++ community for the community, offering inspirational talks and a friendly atmosphere. Whether you are a C++ novice or an expert, CppCon will appeal to anyone interested in programming and software development.

CppCon is the annual, week-long face-to-face gathering for the entire C++ community. The conference is organized by the C++ community for the community. You will enjoy inspirational talks and a friendly atmosphere designed to help attendees learn from each other, meet interesting people, and generally have a stimulating experience. Taking place this year in Aurora, Colorado, near the Denver airport, and including multiple diverse tracks, the conference will appeal to anyone from C++ novices to experts.
